articles.title: Strait of Hormuz Attack: Commercial Vessel Struck Amid Escalating Naval Blockade
articles.excerpt: A commercial tanker was struck by an unknown projectile while transiting the Strait of Hormuz, causing a confirmed casualty and sending crude prices higher amid an escalating maritime blockade.
articles.imageAlt: Commercial oil supertanker navigating contested international waters in the Strait of Hormuz
articles.author: Monu Sharma
